contexts.text: Jesus Christ is acknowledged and adored as Lord in universal Heaven.
The style of the Most Ancient Church, which they adored.
From beyond the rivers of Ethiopia my suppliants. ().
Outward adoration without the adoration of the heart.
Such are very prone to adore any god or idol that favours their cupidities.

The essential of worship is the adoration of the Lord from the heart... in charity the Lord is present, and then He can be adored from the heart; thus adoration is from the Lord, for the Lord gives all the posse and all the esse in adoration; hence such as is the charity with a man such is the adoration, or worship; all worship is adoration, because the adoration of the Lord must be in it to make it worship.
All the differences of both outward and inward worship are according to the adoration of the Lord in it, and adoration is according to love to the Lord and towards the neighbour.
All true worship consists in the adoration of the Lord, the adoration of the Lord (consists in) humiliation... the more a man is in humiliation the more he is in adoration, that is, in true worship.
Inward worship, from which is adoration.
Thou shalt worship the Lord thy God.

Abram fell upon his faces = adoration. This was a rite of adoring in the Most Ancient Church... True adoration or humiliation of heart has in it prostration on the earth upon the face before the Lord... it is otherwise with adoration that is not from humiliation of heart.
That the Lord adored and prayed to Jehovah His Father... In His state of humiliation He adored Jehovah as another than Himself. AC 2159:3.

So far as a man is in the acknowledgement of self, so far he can be in true humiliation, and so far in adoration when he is in worship; if humiliation is separated from worship there is nothing of adoration, thus nothing of worship.
They who are truly men of the Church... adore the Lord alone...
A dissimilar state of humiliation and thence of adoration (in these two cases).

How greatly the adoration, and thus the worship, of those who are in the affection of truth differs from that of those who are in the affection of good: for in order that there may be worship there must be adoration, and that there may be adoration there must be humiliation in all and every single thing of worship.
The Gentiles who have adored another god... They also who have adored men... How instructed? HH 326.
They who are in self-love only adore themselves as gods, and so also will to be adored by others, in all that they do being intent upon that.

The Most Ancient Church adored the Infinite Esse, and thence the Infinite Existing, and because they could have no perception of the Infinite Esse... they adored the Infinite Existing in which was the Infinite Esse.
Adoration signified by the bowing of the sheaves. AC 4689.
They who live the life of faith adore the Lord on bended knees and with a humble heart as God the Saviour. AC 4731:end.
The acknowledgement and adoration of the Lord's Divine Human is the life of religion.
The adoring of a trinity that is not a unity... When three gods are adored where is the Church then?
Bend the knee = adoration.
If adoration is from genuine humiliation...

The ceremony of this adoration arose when it was known what was represented, and kings did not then attribute the adoration to themselves... royalty with them was the law, which, because it was from Divine truth, was to be adored in the king as its guardian... adoration other than that of the law in the king would be idolatry.
The Lord does indeed require humiliation, adoration, etc., but only for man's own sake. Explained.
They who are in adoration of God from the heart thus bow themselves.
They who are in truth and not yet in good adore outward things, and do not care for inward ones.

They adore the Divine not as a Divine utterly incomprehensible... and since they adore the Divine under a human form they adore the Lord... They said that they adore with most holy worship the Divine that shines as a sun in Heaven...
That in ancient times they adored Jehovah under a Divine Human.
They who approach dead men with supplication as holy, and thus adore them...
(A kind of Spirits from Jupiter who suffer themselves to be adored by others.)
Those of them who love themselves, adore what belongs to themselves, and also will that they should be adored by others, yea as gods...
Humiliation and adoration from the heart. Signified. The essential of all adoration and of all worship is humiliation...
The Israelitish people were not in such humiliation and adoration, but only represented it... They who adore from the love of God from themselves, adore from the love of self...
Incense = those things of worship that are gratefully perceived, as confessions, adorations, prayers.
They who place all worship in adoration and in prayers... when yet the Lord regards nothing else in the man who is in adoration and prayers but his heart...
To adore = to worship as good itself, to sacrifice = to worship as truth itself.
If those who are in mere externals venerate and adore God it is for their own sake... this is the fire that excites their veneration and adoration.
To adore = worship.
[Swedenborg footnote 1.] To adore the sun = to adore those things that are contrary to heavenly love or to the Lord. HH 561. [Swedenborg footnote 1.]
A certain nation that at this day adores the Lord.
Adore. Illustrated.
They call adorations that belong to worship signs of charity.
Who adore the sun and moon...
To adore the sun of the world is also to acknowledge nature as the creatress...
Adoration from the deepest humiliation. Signified.

They cast themselves down... and adored Him who liveth for ever and ever = the humiliation of all in Heaven before the Lord... and from humiliation adoration. AR 370. AR 808. ( = humiliation and thence acknowledgement with the heart. AE 291.)
To adore demons = to be in evils of concupiscences.
To adore idols = worship from falsities.
They who adore = the Church as to worship... They who adore, here, = the adoration that is of worship. AE 629.
They adored the dragon... To adore = to acknowledge as a holy thing of the Church. AE 789. AR 580. AR 588. AR 597. AR 630.
And they adored the beast.... To adore = to acknowledge for certain and thence to worship as Divine. AE 790.
And all the dwellers upon the earth adored it. ... To adore = to acknowledge and believe that it is so and thence to receive it in doctrine and worship. AE 805.
And they caused that the earth and the dwellers therein should adore the former beast. To adore = to acknowledge for certain, to acknowledge in heart, and to believe. AE 821. AE 833. AE 885.
Adore Him who... To adore = to acknowledge in heart, thus to confess and worship. AE 876.
To adore the beast and his image, = to acknowledge that faith and receive its doctrine. AE 891.
To adore before Him = to acknowledge the Lord as God... To adore = to acknowledge with the heart and to worship. AE 945.
They adored God Who sitteth upon the throne = the adoration of the Lord as God of Heaven and earth and as the Judge of the Universe. To adore = adoration from humiliation of heart. AE 1207.
Hence it was an abomination to adore towards the sun, moon and stars.
Hence in adorations they turned their faces to the rising sun.
They indeed speak blandly to them so long as they adore them.
These, although they adore God do not trust in Him, but in themselves.
When he flew upwards he would adore God, and when downwards he would adore the devil.
To adore any vicar upon earth...
Blaspheming the God whom in the outward man they have adored.
On a Hell where they adore each other as gods.
I fell at His feet = adoration from humiliation of heart for the Divine.
Crying with a great voice = adoration from the good of truth and thence joy of heart.
They adored God = thanksgiving that so many were saved.
To adore God is testification of humiliation of heart through truths from the good of love.
To adore Him = worship from the good of love.
